business_problem: Cars24 needed to manage a fragmented, conversation-heavy vehicle marketplace and its internal workstreams without scaling support, sales, and engineering headcount linearly with customer growth.
solution_summary: Cars24 built OpenAI-powered voice and chat agents to cover the full buyer and seller journey across its automotive marketplace. Buyer-side agents qualify needs, recommend cars from the catalog, book test drives, support financing conversations, and help with after-sales questions. Seller-side agents collect vehicle details, schedule inspections, and re-engage leads that previously fell out of the funnel after 10 days. At the same time, the company rolled out ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex to roughly 600 employees and reoriented project management around Linear so Codex could participate directly in ticket creation, bug handling, work summaries, and cross-team updates. Teams beyond engineering now use Codex to automate workflows in finance, procurement, and internal communication, including chief-of-staff agents that connect Slack, Gmail, WhatsApp, and other systems. Together, these layers make AI both the customer-conversation engine and the internal operating layer for Cars24.

data_flow: Customer calls, chats, catalog data, financing details, and follow-up signals are processed by Cars24's conversational agents to move buyers and sellers through the marketplace. Internally, tickets, financial records, procurement requests, and communication streams flow through ChatGPT Enterprise, Codex, and chief-of-staff agents to automate daily work.
business_outcome: Cars24 increased support resolution, recovered previously lost seller demand, reduced turnaround times, and spread AI-assisted execution from customer operations into software delivery and business operations across the company.
